text:
maria: Quick sync — we need final links + exact rollout timing for the Optimize release announcement. Marketing wants to lock copy by EOD Friday. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jack: Can do. Engineering plan: canary on Tue 03/24 09:00 PT -> gradual ramp for 48h -> full cutover Thu 03/26 09:00 PT. No infra changes, just model variant switch and traffic split. :white_check_mark:

leah: That timeline works for product. Are there any feature callouts we should highlight (e.g., latency % drop, cost/unit)?

jack: Primary callouts: ~30% average latency reduction on 8k seq workloads, 2.2x throughput on batching workloads, and an optional int8 quantized profile that reduces token cost ~40% (with tiny quality delta). Will share short numbers and a tiny changelog snippet in a sec.

sam: Docs is almost ready — staging doc PR at: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612. Rendered preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/optimize-v1. I can publish to production once we have the final release timestamp.

maria: Perfect. Also need: 1) short changelog text for the release post, 2) hero benchmark figure (png or link), 3) webinar slot confirmation (we want a live demo + Q&A same week as release).

jack: Changelog snippet (copyable):
```
- Optimize v1: reduced token latency by ~30% for typical 8k-context workloads, 2.2x throughput gains for batched inference, and optional int8 quantization profile to lower cost by up to 40%.
- Rollout: canary Tue 03/24 09:00 PT, gradual ramp → full Thu 03/26 09:00 PT.
```

leah: Webinar — product suggests Wed 03/25 11:00 PT (fits EMEA and NA overlap). Marketing to confirm host and panelists. :calendar:

maria: Tentatively reserve Wed 03/25 11:00 PT. Can we get a benchmark PNG? Either a latency distribution or cost-per-token comparison favored.

jack: I'll ask bench-team to export two graphs: latency CDF (8k workload) and cost/token bar chart across model profiles. ETA for images: Monday EOD.

sam: Linking PR for the short API example to include in post: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/98. Example snippet ready, will switch to prod docs link once publish goes live.

maria: Lead routing — can we add a UTM so inbound webinar signups route to SDR queue A? We need a UTM_campaign param and landing page published by noon Tue so SDRs have time to prep.

leah: Yes — marketing/SDR will coordinate. @maria can you confirm the exact query param you want?

maria: Use utm_campaign=optimize_v1_launch and utm_source=webinar. Also request SDRs get an alert for signups via Intercom + new tag `optimize_v1`.

jack: Deploy-bot reports: optimize-v1 staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-23T18:00Z. Will run smoke tests and auto-rollback on failure.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled deploy "optimize-v1" -> staging at 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z. Smoke tests: enabled. Auto-rollback: enabled.

maria: Great. Two last asks: 1) embargo window? prefer we hold press until full cutover Thu morning. 2) final copy approval by Friday noon so marketing can hit publish at Thu 09:15 PT (15 minutes after cutover).

leah: Product OK with embargo until Thu 09:15 PT. PR/press: embargo lift at Thu 09:15 PT.

jack: Confirming no expected breaking changes. Engineering prefers publish at +15m post-cutover to validate metrics on production.

maria: Awesome. I'll draft the announcement + post with the changelog and link placeholders: docs link -> will swap to https://redwood.ai/docs/optimize-v1 when Sam flips to prod. Webinar registration link -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=optimize_v1_launch&utm_source=webinar.

sam: Once the staging docs are approved, I'll schedule the prod publish job for Thu 09:05 PT to go live at 09:15 PT. I will post the final prod links here when live.

maria: Thanks everyone — timeline recap:
- Mon EOD: bench images in thread (jack)
- Tue 12:00 PT: landing page + UTMs live (marketing)
- Tue 18:00Z: staging deploy (deploy-bot)
- Wed 11:00 PT: webinar live demo
- Thu 09:00 PT: full cutover complete
- Thu 09:15 PT: publish announcement & lift embargo

jack: I'll post a brief rollout status update in this thread during the canary window.

leah: I'll finalize the messaging and speaker list for webinar.

maria: If anyone sees a blocker to the timeline, ping me directly. Otherwise I'll circulate the draft PR for copy by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
